layout_sources: https://community.quickfile.co.uk/t/upload-of-tsb-bank-statement-broken/41983 (TSB export columns: Transaction date, Transaction Type, Sort Code, Account Number, Transaction description, Debit amount, Credit amount, Balance)
https://github.com/BWeesy/gubbins/blob/main/statementflow/profiles/tsb.yaml (same layout as the Lloyds family; newest first; DD/MM/YYYY)
notes: Header words in TSB's own mixed case ("Transaction date", "Transaction description", "Debit amount", "Credit amount"), no trailing comma reported. The rows are not documented: written as the Lloyds family writes them (newest first, DD/MM/YYYY, sort code with a leading apostrophe, positive Debit/Credit amounts, running Balance, no thousands mark), which is the most widely reported shape for this header. One converter says TSB exports omit balances; the forum header has a Balance column, so it is kept. Line endings unknown (LF here).
